verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents its own card issuing: multi-currency Visa cards issued and managed at scale, a corporate cards offering with spend controls, and authorization controls that set rules on how and where cards can be used. The evidence never says whether these cards can be physical, never describes issuing them to individual employees, and never mentions role-based assignment, so only the core issuing capability is shown. Missing for 10: explicit physical card issuance, debit-vs-credit card options, per-employee cardholder assignment, role-based card permissions, independent corroboration.
